earlyExit.intro: The review was not completed and the report is incomplete due to the following issues:

findings.message:
This add-on was submitted as a source-code archive, but the built XPI carries vendoring information of its own. In a source-code submission a VENDOR file, a package.json and a lock file belong in the archive - the copy the reviewer reads and the build installs from - not in the package you ship. Remove the file(s) below from the XPI and declare the dependencies in the archive instead. If the add-on needs no archive behind it, submit just the XPI.
Read more: https://webextension-api.thunderbird.net/en/mv3/guides/sourceCodeSubmission.html

The submitted source includes no npm or pnpm lock file. These lock files are needed to ensure reproducibility (via npm ci or pnpm install --frozen-lockfile). Please commit the lock file created by your package manager (package-lock.json or npm-shrinkwrap.json for npm, pnpm-lock.yaml for pnpm). The supported package managers are npm and pnpm.
Read more: https://webextension-api.thunderbird.net/en/mv3/guides/sourceCodeSubmission.html
